debugData.name: decalTireTracks01 albedoAlpha
debugData.description: p309 D1 DECAL albedoAlpha of ambientCG TireTracks001 (CC0): colour × AO, darkened to about 0.38 of its linear value (remap [0, 2.6]: the source is a pale sand strip, and a track pressed into mud reads darker than the ground, not lighter); opacity from the inverted height (remap [0.2, 1.0]: about 0.88 in the pressed grooves, its height ~0.3, and 0.25 on the tread's tops, ~0.8), so the ground shows between the grooves (p309 Phase 5; before, opacity 1 over the pale colour: a painted strip on dark mud). An atlas cell's source only.
